required_vna_capable: KNOWN INTERIM DRIFT (2026-07-31, OI-115a). Correct value is true — the document (title: 'Firefly AGV and VNA User Requirement Specification') requires an 'automatic, unmanned VNA reach truck-type device' in Phase 2 at 1.9-2.0m aisle width. As of the OI-115a commit alone, live extraction flips to false because the field's AP0 hint has a hard 'aisle widths below 1.8 m' threshold that Dragonfly's real value (1.9m) misses — a pre-existing hint defect, not caused by OI-115a (senior-architect verified: the field's own prompt line is byte-identical before/after OI-115a; the reshuffle is a side effect of ~50 neighboring fields' prompt bytes changing in the same batched Pass-4b call). Fix in progress as an immediate follow-up: reword the hint to judge VNA-requirement from what the procured vehicle must do, not a numeric aisle-width cutoff, then re-capture and add a golden_extraction assertion for this field. Remove this entry once that lands and required_vna_capable:true is asserted in golden_extraction above.
